name: Sus
civicNote: One of 23 villages notified into PMC (draft notification Dec 2020, final 2021).
summary: A newer residential area in a valley north-west of Pune, west of Pashan. It was a village before joining PMC and is still urbanising.
knownFor: Surrounded by Baner, Pashan, Sutarwadi and Lavale hills
Newer residential development close to the Hinjewadi IT park
connectivity: Pashan-Sus Road is the main access road
Dehu Road-Katraj bypass lies just off Sus, leading to the Mumbai-Pune Expressway
Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Hinjewadi is about 13 km away
suits: IT professionals working in Hinjewadi or Baner who want a newer, greener area.
